title: Wave anatomy
core_concept: An electromagnetic wave is described by wavelength, frequency, amplitude, phase, polarization and coherence.

title: Transverse field geometry
core_concept: For a plane wave in vacuum, E and B are mutually perpendicular and transverse to propagation.
assumptions_or_caveats: High-NA focusing may introduce longitudinal fields

title: Wavelength and frequency
core_concept: Wavelength is spatial periodicity; frequency counts oscillations per second.

title: Phase and optical cycle
core_concept: Phase locates a wave within its cycle; 2π radians represents one complete oscillation.

title: Field amplitude and intensity
core_concept: In vacuum, ideal plane-wave intensity scales with squared peak electric-field amplitude.

title: Polarization
core_concept: Polarization describes the electric-field vector trajectory: linear, circular or elliptical.
fundamental_principle: Ex and Ey with relative phase

title: Interference
core_concept: Coherent fields superpose; relative phase determines reinforcement or cancellation.

title: Temporal coherence
core_concept: Temporal coherence describes field correlation across time delays.
assumptions_or_caveats: Proportionality depends on spectral shape and definition

title: Spatial coherence
core_concept: Spatial coherence measures field correlation between different locations.
assumptions_or_caveats: Depends on source and optical propagation

title: Phase velocity
core_concept: A constant-phase point travels at phase velocity.

title: Group velocity
core_concept: A narrowband pulse envelope propagates approximately at group velocity.

title: Pulse bandwidth
core_concept: Finite-duration optical pulses require a range of frequencies.

title: Spectral phase
core_concept: Spectral components must have suitable relative phases to form short pulses.
assumptions_or_caveats: Dispersion can broaden a pulse without changing its bandwidth

title: 1064.8 nm optical period
core_concept: A 1064.8 nm vacuum wavelength corresponds to about 281.55 THz and a 3.552 fs period.
microscopy_relevance: Distinguishes carrier oscillations from pulse duration

title: Multiphoton relevance
core_concept: In the perturbative regime, two-photon excitation scales with instantaneous intensity squared.
assumptions_or_caveats: Unsaturated excitation; molecular and optical factors fixed
microscopy_relevance: High peak intensity of pulses enhances excitation
